ellipse_phantom — TOMOGRAPHY forward op

• Data kinds: कोई नहीं → image2d (केवल arguments से तय होने वाला op — यह कोई image या data input नहीं लेता)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ellipse_phantom(size=256, ellipses=None, supersample=4) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import tomography; tomography.ellipse_phantom(size=256, ellipses=None, supersample=4), registry से लेना हो तो opstomography.get("ellipse_phantom"))

उपयोग

uniform ellipse के योग को *size* x *size* slice पर rasterise करता है।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

The default is SHEPP_LOGAN. The normalised square [-1, 1]^2 maps onto the grid, so x = (col - (size-1)/2) / (size/2); the same mapping is used by ellipse_sinogram, which is what makes the two comparable without a fudge factor.

*supersample* is the anti-aliasing factor: each pixel is the mean of supersample^2 sub-samples, so an edge pixel carries its true area fraction. This is not cosmetic — a hard 0/1 rasterisation projects to a sinogram that disagrees with the closed form by 0.276 % interior RMS of the peak, against 0.073 % anti-aliased (measured), and the difference is entirely the partial-volume edge.

:param size: side of the square grid, 2 .. 16384. :param ellipses: (N, 6) rows (x0, y0, a, b, phi_deg, rho) in

normalised coordinates; None -> SHEPP_LOGAN.

:param supersample: anti-alias factor per axis, 1 .. 16. :returns: (size, size) float64 image; the Shepp-Logan default spans

[0.0, 1.0].

:raises ValueError: on a non-int size, a degenerate ellipse, or a grid over

MAX_IMAGE_ELEMENTS.
